7798:            run_dir,
7799:            verification_ref,
7800:            attestation_sha256=state.get("verification_attestation_sha256"),
7801:            expected_task_id=task_id,
7802:            expected_base_commit=base_commit,
7803:            expected_candidate_id=expected_candidate,
7804:            expected_command=normalize_test_command(config.test_command) if config.test_command else None,
7805:        )
7806:        verification_sha256 = verification_contract["attestation_sha256"]
7807:        if pending.get("verification_sha256") != verification_sha256:
7808:            raise FactoryError("pending commit verification digest is not bound to the approval", "blocked")
7809:        review_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(review_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
7810:        if pending.get("review_sha256") != review_sha256:
7811:            raise FactoryError("pending commit review artifact integrity is stale", "blocked")
7812:        if review.get("verification") != verification_contract:
7813:            raise FactoryError("pending commit verification is not bound to the approval", "blocked")
7814:
7815:        head = git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
7816:        if head != base_commit:
7817:            parent = git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD^").stdout.strip()
7818:            tree = git(worktree, "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}").stdout.strip()
7819:            if parent != base_commit or tree != expected_candidate:
7820:                raise FactoryError("pending commit does not match the approved base/tree", "blocked")

7825:                or post_commit_state.get("status_records")

7830:                or not post_commit_state["clean"]

7833:                    "pending commit has post-approval candidate mutations",
7834:                    "blocked",

7837:                worktree, "diff", f"{base_commit}..{head}", "--binary", "--no-ext-diff"
7838:            ).stdout
7839:            validate_review(
7840:                review,
7841:                hashlib.sha256(committed_diff.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
7842:                base_commit,
7843:                expected_candidate,
7844:                list(task.get("global_criteria", []))
7845:                + [item["id"] for item in task.get("acceptance_criteria", [])],
7846:                verification_contract,
7847:                predecessor_review=self._load_review_predecessor(run_dir, review),

7850:                raise FactoryError("pending commit reconciliation requires Sol APPROVE", "blocked")

7852:        else:

7854:            current_hash = hashlib.sha256(staged_diff.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

7857:            current_candidate_state = AgyBuilder._candidate_baseline_identity(worktree)
7858:            reviewed_candidate_state = state.get("candidate_state_identity")
7859:            validate_review(
7860:                review,
7861:                current_hash,
7862:                base_commit,
7863:                expected_candidate,
7864:                list(task.get("global_criteria", []))
7865:                + [item["id"] for item in task.get("acceptance_criteria", [])],
7866:                verification_contract,
7867:                predecessor_review=self._load_review_predecessor(run_dir, review),
7868:            )
7869:            if review.get("decision") != "APPROVE":
7870:                raise FactoryError("pending commit reconciliation requires Sol APPROVE", "blocked")
7871:            if current_tree != expected_candidate or unstaged_diff:
7872:                raise FactoryError("pending candidate changed before commit reconciliation", "blocked")
7873:            if (
7874:                not isinstance(reviewed_candidate_state, dict)

7876:                != reviewed_candidate_state.get("complete_identity_sha256")
7877:            ):
7878:                raise FactoryError("pending candidate state changed before commit reconciliation", "blocked")

7880:                f"hermes: {task['objective'].strip()[:68]}\n\n"

7886:            )

7888:            if committed.returncode != 0:

7890:                    f"pending commit reconciliation failed: {(committed.stderr or committed.stdout).strip()}",

7895:                raise FactoryError("reconciled commit tree does not match the pending candidate", "blocked")
7896:
7897:        completed_commits = state.get("completed_commits")
7898:        if not isinstance(completed_commits, list):
7899:            raise FactoryError("run completed_commits state is invalid", "state")
7900:        completed_commits = list(completed_commits)

7965:    def _validate_terminal_state(
7966:        self,
7967:        identifier: str,
7968:        run_dir: Path,
7969:        state: dict[str, Any],
7970:        config: Config,
7971:    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
7972:        """Revalidate a terminal snapshot before trusting its fast path."""
7973:        def invalid(reason: str) -> None:
7974:            self._save(
7975:                run_dir,
7976:                state,
7977:                "blocked",
7978:                block_reason=reason,
7979:                error=reason,
7980:                error_category="blocked",
7981:            )
7982:            raise FactoryError(reason, "blocked")
7983:
7984:        try:
7985:            plan = self._load_master_plan_for_execution(run_dir, config, state)
7986:            tasks = master_plan_tasks(plan)
7987:            completed = state.get("completed_commits")
7988:            if not isinstance(completed, list) or not completed:
7989:                invalid("terminal state has no completed commit history")
7990:            task_ids: set[str] = set()
7991:            plan_ids = {task["id"] for task in tasks}
7992:            for record in completed:
7993:                if not isinstance(record, dict):
7994:                    invalid("terminal state has an invalid completed commit record")
7995:                task_id = record.get("task_id")
7996:                commit = record.get("commit")
7997:                candidate_id = record.get("candidate_id")
7998:                base_commit = record.get("base_commit")
7999:                if (
8000:                    not isinstance(task_id, str)
8001:                    or task_id in task_ids
8002:                    or not isinstance(commit, str)
8003:                    or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", commit)
8004:                    or not isinstance(candidate_id, str)
8005:                    or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", candidate_id)
8006:                    or not isinstance(base_commit, str)
8007:                    or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", base_commit)
8008:                ):
8009:                    invalid("terminal state has an invalid or duplicate completed commit record")
8010:                if task_id not in plan_ids:
8011:                    invalid("terminal state references a task absent from the master plan")
8012:                task_ids.add(task_id)
8013:                if git(Path(config.repo), "rev-parse", f"{commit}^").stdout.strip() != base_commit:
8014:                    invalid("terminal state commit parent does not match its recorded base")
8015:                if git(Path(config.repo), "rev-parse", f"{commit}^{{tree}}").stdout.strip() != candidate_id:
8016:                    invalid("terminal state commit tree does not match its recorded candidate")
8017:            if task_ids != plan_ids:
8018:                invalid("terminal state is missing a committed master-plan task")
8019:            if state.get("commit") != completed[-1].get("commit"):
8020:                invalid("terminal state latest commit is not bound to completed history")
8021:            if state.get("current_task_id") is not None:
8022:                invalid("terminal state retains a current task")
8023:            if any(state.get(key) is not None for key in ("candidate_id", "pending_commit", "active_attempt_ref")):
8024:                invalid("terminal state retains an ambiguous candidate or attempt")
8025:            if state.get("test_results") not in (None, []):
8026:                invalid("terminal state retains duplicate mutable Runner result state")
